# JieLi AC79 SDK files

Three files of JieLi's AC79 SDK (`fw-AC79_AIoT_SDK`, tag `AC79NN_SDK_V1.2.1_2023-12-13`, on gitee), in the SDK's own
layout, kept here so a build needs no download: `tools/fm1pkg_make.py` puts them into the firmware package.

- `cpu/wl82/tools/uboot.boot`
- `cpu/wl82/tools/cfg_tool.bin`
- `cpu/wl82/tools/cfg/eq_cfg_hw.bin`

They are JieLi's, unchanged, under the SDK's Apache-2.0 licence (`LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`, LICENSING.md); not part of
Flyfish's GPL-3.0 code.
